            .Bind(configuration.GetSection("Storage"))
            .Validate(options =>

                var section = configuration.GetSection("Storage");

            .PostConfigure(options =>
            {
                // Add to shared cache for early access
                global::Atc.OptionsBinding.OptionsInstanceCache.Add(options, "MyApp");
            });

        return services;
